Advertising Services Privacy Policy | Adagio Integrations Open Bidding Sign in Request a demo Open main menu Advertising Services Privacy Policy Last updated: July 1, 2026 IP addresses Your IP address is a number assigned by your Internet Service Provider to any Internet connection. It is not always specific to your device and is not always a stable identifier. Device characteristics Technical characteristics about the device you are using that are not unique to you, such as the language, time zone, or operating system. Device identifiers A device identifier is a unique string of characters assigned to your device or browser by means of a cookie or other storage technologies. It may be created or access to recognize your device, e.g. across web pages from the same site or across multiple sites or apps. Probablistic identifiers A probabilistic identifier can be created by combining characteristics associated with your device (the type of browser or operating system used) and the IP address of the Internet connection. If you give your agreement, additional characteristics (e.g. the installed font or screen resolution) can also be combined to improve precision of the probabilistic identifier. Superior Court of New Jersey, Law Division, Essex County Docket No. ESX-L-003299-25 The domain name peekyou.com is now controlled by Atlas Data Privacy Corporation (“Atlas”). On April 30, 2025 , Atlas and three individual plaintiffs filed a lawsuit in New Jersey Superior Court: Atlas Data Privacy Corporation, et al. v. PeekYou LLC, et al. In the Complaint, Atlas asserted claims assigned to it by approximately 21,700 law enforcement officers, prosecutors, and other “covered persons” under New Jersey’s Daniel’s Law, which protects home addresses and unpublished home telephone numbers from disclosure. Atlas and PeekYou LLC have entered into a settlement agreement, and this lawsuit has now been resolved. Additional information regarding this and other Daniel’s Law cases can be obtained from the Superior Court of New Jersey.
